flora: Araucariaceae (tall, columnar trunk, umbrella-like canopy at the very top)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; focus on the iconic 'Monkey Puzzle' silhouette; the trunk should have a geometric, 'armored' bark texture; canopy appears as a dense, rounded tuft of green.

visual_logic.composition: A heroic upward-looking 'worm's eye view' of a massive Araucarian trunk, tracing the armored bark up to the distinctive canopy against a bright sky.
visual_logic.ground: Dry limestone soil with fallen, triangular leathery leaves scattered around the base.
visual_logic.lighting: Cinematic side-lighting to emphasize the deep, geometric texture of the bark plates.
